followUps.conclusion: That is the Poch. It is built from Unitoy or Kader parts, with a dull-chrome dome and messy paint.

followUps.conclusion: That is the Kader M4. Cavity 5 or 6. It is a short run, with a minor COO variation beside Kader M3 and Kader M7.

followUps.conclusion: That is the Kader M7. Cavity 3 or 4. The paint matches Kader M3, and the two were made alongside each other.

figures.name: Chewbacca
figures.whereToLook: Look on the back of the left thigh. The stamp runs vertically. The licensing line is the first column, and the country text is beside it. A partial or cut-off country name counts as No COO. The picture is COO guide 3.2.
stamps: Unitoy M1 = '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh. The M of MADE is directly under the ©, and the K of KONG is under the second 7 of 1977.
Poch Unitoy = the same MADE IN HONG KONG line, on Unitoy parts. Large turquoise eyes.

Kader M2.1 = '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh. The H of HONG starts under the ©, to its right, and the G of KONG ends under the second 7 of 1977. The licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977.
Poch Kader = the Kader Hong Kong line. Purple-brown pouch.
Smile M3 = '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh. The H of HONG starts under the middle of the ©, and the G of KONG is under the second G of G.M.F.G.I.
Taiwan M4 = '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN TAIWAN' on the back of the left thigh.
PBP M1 = No COO. The licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. Circle under the left foot on cavity 2b.
Smile M5 = No COO. The licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. Large almond-shaped eyes.
Lili Ledy M5 = No COO. The licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. Much darker plastic.
Kader M2.2 = No COO. The licensing line reads L.F.L. 1977. POTF re-stamp.
Glasslite M2 = No COO. The licensing line reads L.F.L. 1977. Unpainted pouch.
Top Toys M6 = No COO. The licensing line reads L.F.L. 1977. The only Top Toys figure with a date.
Green limbs are faded pigment, not a variant.

options.label: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh. The M of MADE is directly under the ©, and the K of KONG is under the second 7 of 1977
examples: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh. The M of MADE is directly under the ©, and the K of KONG is under the second 7 of 1977

followUps.label: Small blue pupils and a swollen big toe on the left foot
followUps.conclusion: That is the Unitoy M1. The M of MADE is directly under the ©, and the K of KONG is under the second 7 of 1977. Small blue pupils and a swollen big toe on the left foot.

followUps.label: Large turquoise eyes, or melt marks on the arm or shoulder
followUps.conclusion: That is the Poch built from Unitoy parts. Large turquoise eyes. Melt marks on the arm or shoulder. The Hong Kong line matches Unitoy.

options.label: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh
examples: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'HONG KONG' on the back of the left thigh

followUps.label: The H of HONG starts under the ©, to its right, and the G of KONG ends under the second 7 of 1977. Small mid-blue pupils
followUps.conclusion: That is the Kader M2.1. The H of HONG starts under the ©, to its right, and the G of KONG ends under the second 7 of 1977. Small mid-blue pupils and small eye whites. The licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. Green limbs are faded pigment, not a variant.

followUps.label: The H of HONG starts under the ©, to its right, and the G of KONG ends under the second 7 of 1977. The pouch is purple-brown
followUps.conclusion: That is the Poch built from Kader parts. The H of HONG starts under the ©, to its right, and the G of KONG ends under the second 7 of 1977. The pouch is purple-brown. Green limbs are faded pigment, not a variant.

followUps.label: The H of HONG starts under the middle of the ©, and the G of KONG is under the second G of G.M.F.G.I.
followUps.conclusion: That is the Smile M3. The H of HONG starts under the middle of the ©, and the G of KONG is under the second G of G.M.F.G.I. The bowcaster is Smile M4 on SW and ESB cards, then Smile M3 from the 65b/c.

options.label: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN TAIWAN' on the back of the left thigh
examples: '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN TAIWAN' on the back of the left thigh
options.conclusion: That is the Taiwan M4. '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977' and 'MADE IN TAIWAN' run vertically on the back of the left thigh. 12-back and 21-back only.

options.label: No COO. The licensing line reads '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977'
examples: No COO. The licensing line reads '© G.M.F.G.I. 1977'

followUps.label: Much darker plastic than a Kenner Chewbacca
followUps.conclusion: That is the Lili Ledy M5. No COO, and the licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. The plastic is much darker than a Kenner Chewbacca.

followUps.label: A circle under the left foot, or reddish plastic with melt marks
followUps.conclusion: That is the PBP M1. No COO. Reddish plastic with melt marks. Cavity 2b has a large circle under the left foot.

followUps.label: Large almond-shaped eyes
followUps.conclusion: That is the Smile M5. No COO, and the licensing line reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977. Large almond-shaped eyes. The sheet's family 3 No COO Smile has the same eyes. The bowcaster is Smile M3.

options.label: No COO. The licensing line reads '© L.F.L. 1977'
examples: No COO. The licensing line reads '© L.F.L. 1977'

followUps.label: Unpainted pouch and much lighter brown plastic
followUps.conclusion: That is the Glasslite M2. No COO, and the licensing line reads L.F.L. 1977. Much lighter brown than a Kenner Chewbacca, with an unpainted pouch. It came with a Zuckuss-style rifle, not a bowcaster.

followUps.label: Unpainted pouch, a shorter figure, and no peg holes under the feet
followUps.conclusion: That is the Top Toys M6. No COO, and the licensing line reads L.F.L. 1977. It is shorter, with no peg holes under the feet, and an unpainted pouch. This is the only Top Toys figure with a date.

followUps.label: A painted pouch on reddish-brown plastic
followUps.conclusion: That is the Kader M2.2. No COO. The Hong Kong text was removed and the line was re-stamped '© L.F.L. 1977'. POTF cards and baggies. The earlier Hong Kong Kader still reads G.M.F.G.I. 1977.
